# coach kris.

> Certified life, longevity and business coaching by phone or video across the UK and Ireland. Founded by Kristian Sokol, creator of the "Break the Loop" method: seek discomfort to find comfort.

Kris coaches people who keep circling the same problem: loops in life, health and business. £45 an hour, no packages. ADHD-aware, action-focused, evidence-aware. Sessions run by phone or video.

- [Home](https://www.coachkris.co.uk/): what coaching with Kris looks like, how it works, book a session
- [Blog](https://www.coachkris.co.uk/blog.html): articles on life coaching, longevity, mindset, ADHD-aware coaching, growth
- [The Voice You Feed](https://www.coachkris.co.uk/vyf.html): the 7-day self-experiment workbook, the €17 entry product
- [Legal](https://www.coachkris.co.uk/legal.html): terms and conditions
